chunks.l2: [par-p01-v01] Veneration to Śiva, whose very self is all the levels of reality. Here begins the Entering-into-the-Supreme, composed by glorious Kṣemarāja, noblest of the great Māheśvara teachers. We bow to consciousness itself — the heart of the supreme Lord — which has the world for its form and yet goes beyond it, pulsing in the shape of supreme power.
